tools.name: recommend
tools.description: Rank verified x402 endpoints for a task. On the HTTP transport this call is paid (HTTP 402, then PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). The stdio process reads the local index directly.

tools.name: check_endpoint
tools.description: Probe one public URL for a live HTTP 402 challenge and compare it with the catalog entry when one exists. Does not pay.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Free, rate-limited catalog search. Includes listings that have not been probed yet.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
